_meta.immunityRule: a damage type with mask M cannot damage a bloon with props P when M & P != 0

AuraBloon.desc: Aura Bloons radiate a Bloon buffing field. Bloons within the aura move faster. When popped releases 3 of each Red, Blue, Green, Yellow & Pink Bloons.

DiamondBloon.desc: Diamond Bloons only take 1 damage from any projectile, and they reduce the pierce of projectiles hitting the Bloon by 5. They are immune to all movement impairment. When popped releases 1 Fortified Ceramic Bloon.

DynamiteBloon.desc: Dynamite Bloons become unstable after taking enough damage and will explode if not popped. The explosion will damage other Bloons and also stun nearby Monkeys. Dynamite Bloons take extra damage from fire and explosion damage. When popped releases 2 Black Bloons and 3 Regrow Red Bloons.

GlassBloon.desc: Glass Bloons are immune to energy and plasma attacks. Projectiles that can't damage the Bloon bounce off. When popped releases 1 Camo Zebra Bloon and 1 Regrow Zebra Bloon.

RetributionBloon.desc: Retribution Bloons are immune to getting slowed. Every few hits, the Retribution Bloon will momentarily stun the attacking Monkey. When the Bloon is destroyed, the Monkey that finished it off is stunned for a few seconds. When popped releases 4 Yellow Bloons and 2 Purple Bloons.

RingleaderBloon.desc: Ringleader Bloons project a barrier that absorbes all pierce from projectiles that hit it. Projectiles hitting the barrier damage it. When the barrier is destroyed it will restore after several seconds. While the barrier is active, Bloons inside have their speed capped. When popped releases 3 Rainbow Bloons.

Bloonarius.name: Bloonarius
Bloonarius.tagLine: From the Swampy Depths - The Inflator Awakens!
Bloonarius.info:
• Sludge-dwelling Bloonarius spews Bloons as it takes damage.
• When each skull on its health bar is reached, Bloonarius disgorges massive Bloon clusters onto the track.
• Bloonarius' sludge infused husk makes it slow but extremely tough.

Blastapopoulos.name: Blastapopoulos
Blastapopoulos.tagLine: Shrouded in Suffocating Heat - Demon of the Core!
Blastapopoulos.info:
• Blastapopoulos has Purple Bloon properties, and Monkey Towers and Heroes suffer from reduced range and slower ability cooldowns during the fight.
• At each Skull Blastapopoulos heats up and spews out Fireballs and Pyroclastic Rocks. Fireballs will target Towers and Heroes with pools of magma that prevent selling and ability cooldowns, and reduce tower range and attack speed even more. Pyroclastic Rocks land in a circle, blocking line of sight until they expire.
• Most projectile hits heat up Blastapopoulos, with fire, plasma, and lasers increasing heat even more, so use those at your own risk! Or you could use some Ice attacks to cool Blastapopoulos down! When the heat bar is completely filled, Blastapopoulos explodes in rage, briefly stunning all Monkeys and increasing ability cooldowns. The leftover heat causes most projectiles to burn up faster than normal.
• Blastapopoulos passively burns off Sticky Bomb and other damaging effects applied to them, reducing the length of damage over time.

Diamondback.name: Diamondback
Diamondback.tagLine: Snaking Through the Ground - The Village Devourer!
Diamondback.info:
• Diamondback has multiple segments and regularly spits Bloons forwards on the track.
• Diamondback's head blocks projectiles from piercing through to its body.
• The Rattle Tail is shielded from damage, break through the shield to stun and debuff Diamondback temporarily!
• Diamondback releases Diamond Bloons that only take 1 damage at a time.
• When each skull is reached, Diamondback sheds a middle segment, spawns many Bloons and regenerates the Rattle Tail shield.

Dreadbloon.name: Dreadbloon
Dreadbloon.tagLine: From Deep Within the Dark Earth... - the Armored Behemoth!
Dreadbloon.info:
•Dreadbloon has Lead properties and reduces all incoming damage by 1.
• When each skull is reached, Dreadbloon grows a Ceramic Armor Shell and Dreadrock Bloons will begin spawning at the start of the track.
• When Dreadbloon appears, it is immune to Primary towers. At each skull, this immunity changes to a different tower type: Military, Magic, Support.
• Dreadrock Bloons and the Ceramic Armor Shell also have these immunities.
• Dreadrock Bloons have a Strong taunt, be careful what your towers are targeting!

Lych.name: Lych
Lych.info:
• Gravelord Lych drains buffs from your Monkeys and has regenerative properties.
• Lych regularly summons Bloon Tombs which summon MOAB-class Bloons. Destroy them asap!
• When each skull on its health bar is reached, Lych goes ethereal and Lych souls are summoned.
• When ethereal, Lych cannot be damaged until all Lych souls have been popped.
• Zombie MOAB-class Bloons do not spawn children.
• While Lych is on the map, sellback value of all Monkeys is reduced significantly.

Phayze.name: Phayze
Phayze.tagLine: The Reality Warper - Invades from the Chaos Rift!
Phayze.info:
• Phayze has the Camo property and a Reality Shield that increases its speed while the Shield is active.
• When each skull is reached, Phayze rebuilds the Reality Shield and warps forward, opening a tear in the fabric of reality allowing Bloons to spawn further along the track.
• Skulls also trigger a slow aura around Phayze, reducing the attack speed of all Monkey Towers.
• Phayze triggers Radar Jam every 24 seconds, disabling Camo-seeing buffs as well as restoring its Camo property if it has been stripped.
• Radar Jam also pulls Bloons to Phayze's location and grants them the Camo property.

Vortex.name: Vortex
Vortex.tagLine: From the skies comes - Deadly Master of Air
Vortex.info:
• Vortex moves like lightning and speeds other Bloons along!
• When each health bar skull is reached, Vortex shields itself and sends out a shockwave that stuns nearby Towers before retreating up the track.
• Vortex emits a regular storm pulse, destroying projectiles, including any non-Powers on the track.

freeplaySpeed.what: Bloon speed multiplier from round 81 (all bloons). Additive bands.

freeplayBlimpHealth.what: MOAB-class health multiplier from round 81. Additive bands.
freeplayBlimpHealth.source: https://www.bloonswiki.com/Freeplay (fetched 2026-11-07). The page lists 101-125 as +5% but its own endpoints (R125 = 2.75, R126 = 2.90) put the +15% step at R125; the Bloons Wiki round table RBE for R125 (939,624 standard, 981,096 ABR) only reproduces with R125 = 2.75.

superCeramic.what: From round 81 every Ceramic is a Super Ceramic, and every non-MOAB-class bloon spawns only ONE child.

v57.what: v57.0-57.4 bloon/boss/round changes (export is v56). None touch regular rounds, regular bloons or normal boss events; Boss Rush bosses were retuned (not modelled here).
